mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_chunk_index_states ( id, space_id, source_document_id, chunk_record_id, chunk_id, content_hash, chunk_version, embedding_provider, embedding_model, embedding_version, dimension, vector_json, status, error_message, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{entity.id}, #{entity.spaceId}, #{entity.sourceDocumentId}, #{entity.chunkRecordId}, #{entity.chunkId}, #{entity.contentHash}, #{entity.chunkVersion}, #{entity.embeddingProvider}, #{entity.embeddingModel}, #{entity.embeddingVersion}, #{entity.dimension}, #{entity.vectorJson}, #{entity.status}, #{entity.errorMessage}, #{entity.createdAt}, #{entity.updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE vector_json = VALUES(vector_json), status = VALUES(status), error_message = VALUES(error_message), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
